query_interpretation.intent: Compare phase distribution of pembrolizumab and nivolumab trials.

notes: 'pembrolizumab': analysed 1000 of 2528 matching trials (capped at 1000); this series is a sample, not registry totals.
'nivolumab': analysed 1000 of 1663 matching trials (capped at 1000); this series is a sample, not registry totals.
'Not Specified' covers studies with no phase recorded (typically observational); it is distinct from 'Not Applicable'.
Studies registered under multiple phases (e.g. 'Phase 1/Phase 2') form their own bucket and are not counted under each phase, so bucket counts sum to the study count.
Each group was queried against ClinicalTrials.gov independently; a trial matching more than one group is counted once in each.
